csv_project_name: Design for Benton Cyber Lab and Offices Renovation & Add
csv_scope_of_work: Benton County, Arkansas is requesting Statements of Qualification from firms interested in providing Architectural Services - Cyber Lab and Offices located at 1300 SW 14th Street, Bentonville, AR 72712. The scope of work includes architectural services for the renovation and addition to hold the cyber lab and offices for investigators. Work will involve as follows: a. Renovation of current building to accommodate the cyber lab and offices. b. An addition of a smaller building attached to the existing building, on an existing concrete slab. c. Capacity to hold eleven (11) workspaces, a lobby, two (2) bathrooms, breakroom, Faraday room, and conference room. d. Concrete slab to support a new generator for the building. e. Building to include plumbing, electrical, and IT connections throughout. f. Building to include heating and air unit. The architect will provide design, construction documents, permitting support, and limited construction administration.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management
